bridge_recovery_limits.source: overnight-route06 observed jumps and measured bridge heights
bridge_recovery_limits.derivation: About 530 cm remaining ascent / observed minimum 16 cm per jump = 34 jumps rounded up; allow 2 additional attempts. 36 * observed upper-stair cycle about 4.9 s = 176.4 s, bounded at 180 s.
bridge_recovery_limits.boundary: Finite test input budget, not a production rule or a guarantee of traversal; real progress, falling/landing, original endpoints and all raid checks remain required.

hold_observation.boundary: Sampled authority snapshots, not per-frame observation; file publication and scheduling may add latency.

sale.ownership_scope: all live server player, account, loot and guard containers
